# ToolBox4Devs (toolbox4devs.com)

> ToolBox4Devs is a suite of 97 fast, private, 100% browser-based developer utilities. Every tool runs client-side in the browser's JavaScript runtime with zero backend roundtrips, zero cookies, zero analytics trackers, and zero telemetry.

<!-- Generated from src/tools/registry.ts by `npm run catalog`. Do not edit by hand. -->

## System Guarantees
- **100% Client-Side Privacy**: No text, tokens, API keys, JSON payloads, or data ever leaves the user's browser.
- **Offline Capable & Zero Latency**: Instant synchronous execution using Web APIs, Web Crypto, and JavaScript.
- **No Ads, Paywalls, or Accounts**: Free to use without authentication.

## Tools Directory

### JSON Tools
- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/json-formatter): Format, validate, query, filter, repair, and inspect JSON in real time with non-blocking Web Worker performance. 100% client-side.
- [JSON → Model](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/json-model): Convert JSON to C# classes or TypeScript interfaces with proper types.
- [JSON to Zod Schema Generator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/json-to-zod): Convert JSON payloads into strongly-typed Zod schemas and TypeScript types.
- [JSON Schema Generator & Validator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/json-schema-generator): Convert JSON payloads into Draft-07, Draft 2020-12, or OpenAPI JSON Schemas with live validation.
- [JSON Diff](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/json-diff): Compare two JSON documents by structure and list every added, removed and changed value by its JSON path.

### Encode / Decode Tools
- [String Escape & Unescape](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/string-escaper): Escape and unescape strings for JSON, JavaScript, Python, Java, C#, SQL, CSV, HTML, and Shell.
- [Base64](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/base64): Encode plain text to Base64 or decode Base64 back to plain text.
- [URL Encoder / Decoder](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/url-encoder): Encode or decode URLs and query string parameters instantly in your browser.
- [HTML Entity Encoder](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/html-entity): Encode plain text into safe HTML entities and decode entity strings back into readable text in your browser.
- [Hash Comparator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/hash-comparator): Compare two hashes or checksums after trimming whitespace and normalizing letter case.
- [Hex Converter](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/hex-converter): Convert text to hexadecimal and hexadecimal back to text.
- [Base32 Encoder / Decoder](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/base32): Encode text to RFC 4648 Base32 or decode Base32 back to text, with optional padding.
- [Image to Base64 / Data URI](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/image-to-base64): Turn an image or small file into Base64, a Data URI, a CSS background-image rule or an HTML img tag, and decode a Data URI back to a preview and file.

### Text Tools
- [Markdown Table to JSON](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/markdown-table-to-json): Convert GitHub-flavored Markdown tables into JSON objects with typed values.
- [Text Diff](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/text-diff): Compare two text blocks line-by-line and highlight every change.
- [Regex Tester & Checker](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/regex): Test and check regular expressions online live against sample text with real-time match and group highlighting.
- [Case Converter](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/case-converter): Convert text between uppercase, lowercase, camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case and more.
- [Slug Generator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/slug-generator): Convert titles and labels into clean kebab-case or snake_case slugs entirely in your browser.
- [CSV to Markdown](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/csv-to-markdown): Convert CSV or TSV data into a well-formatted Markdown table instantly.
- [Line Sorter & Deduplicator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/line-sorter): Sort lines alphabetically, by length, or naturally — remove duplicates, trim whitespace, and drop empty lines.
- [Text Repeater & Multiplier](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/text-repeater): Replicate and repeat text, characters, or strings up to thousands of times with custom separators and formatting options.

### Generators
- [Dockerfile & Container Generator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/dockerfile-generator): Generate production-ready, secure, multi-stage Dockerfiles, .dockerignore, and docker-compose files with built-in security auditing.
- [Docker Run to Compose Converter](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/docker-run-to-compose): Convert single or multi-line docker run commands into clean, production-ready docker-compose.yml YAML configurations instantly.
- [QR Code Generator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/qr-code-generator): 100% Safe & Secure QR Code Generator. Create infinite vector QR codes (SVG, EPS) and high-res PNGs with transparent background, custom shapes, and zero tracking.
- [.gitignore Generator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/gitignore-generator): Generate a clean, deduplicated .gitignore file for your language, framework, editor, and operating system—entirely in your browser.
- [UUID Generator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/uuid): Generate RFC 4122 v4 UUIDs one at a time or in bulk up to 100.
- [NanoID Generator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/nanoid-generator): Generate compact, URL-friendly random IDs with a custom length (4–64) and alphabet, up to 100 at a time.
- [Password Generator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/password-generator): Generate strong, random passwords with customizable length and character sets.
- [Lorem Ipsum Generator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/lorem-ipsum-generator): Create placeholder paragraphs for wireframes, prototypes, content mocks, and layout testing.
- [MAC Address Generator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/mac-address-generator): Generate valid unicast, multicast, locally administered, or vendor-specific MAC addresses in colon, hyphen, or dot formats.
- [SVG Placeholder](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/svg-placeholder-generator): Generate fast, customizable SVG placeholder images for your projects.
- [AI Token Counter & Visualizer](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/ai-token-counter): Estimate token sizes, inspect character segments, and calculate pricing across GPT-4o, Claude, Gemini, and Llama encoders.
- [Faker Data Generator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/faker-data-generator): Generate realistic fake names, emails, phones, addresses, IPs, UUIDs, and sentences for testing — entirely in your browser.
- [Box Shadow Generator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/box-shadow-generator): Build CSS box-shadow values with multiple layers, offsets, blur, spread, colour opacity and inset, with a live preview.
- [ULID & UUID v7 Generator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/ulid-uuidv7-generator): Generate time-sortable ULID and RFC 9562 UUID v7 identifiers with monotonic ordering, and decode timestamps from any ULID or UUID.

### Authentication Tools
- [JWT Decoder](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/jwt): Decode and inspect JSON Web Tokens — header, payload, expiry and more.
- [Basic Auth Header](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/basic-auth-header): Generate and decode HTTP Basic Authorization headers using username and password pairs.
- [JWT Encoder & Token Generator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/jwt-encoder): Create and sign JSON Web Tokens (JWT) with HMAC algorithms (HS256/HS384/HS512) entirely in your browser.

### Web Tools
- [robots.txt & sitemap.xml Generator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/robots-sitemap-generator): Build a robots.txt with user-agent groups, allow and disallow rules, crawl-delay and AI-crawler presets, or a sitemap.xml from a list of URLs.
- [Three.js 3D Scene Studio & Code Playground](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/three-js-playground): Write and test Three.js 3D scene code in real-time with 12+ pre-installed procedural 3D templates, PBR studio lighting, camera controls, and live WebGL preview.
- [WCAG 2.1 Color Contrast Checker](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/wcag-contrast-checker): Test foreground and background color combinations against WCAG 2.1 AA and AAA accessibility standards with live preview and color blindness simulation.
- [cURL to Code Converter](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/curl-converter): Convert cURL commands into clean JavaScript fetch, Node.js Axios, Python requests, Go, Rust, or PHP code snippets instantly.
- [GraphQL Query Formatter](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/graphql-formatter): Format, prettify, validate, and minify GraphQL queries, mutations, and schemas online with custom indentation.
- [SVG to JSX / React Converter](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/svg-to-jsx): Transform raw SVG markup into clean, optimized React JSX / TSX icon components with TypeScript types, custom props, and currentColor support.
- [CSS Unit & Fluid clamp() Converter](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/css-unit-converter): Convert between PX, REM, EM, VW, VH, %, and PT with Tailwind CSS class matching and fluid clamp() generator.
- [Keycode & Keyboard Event Inspector](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/keycode-inspector): Inspect JavaScript KeyboardEvent attributes (key, code, which, keyCode, modifiers) with live keypress capture and event handler code generator.
- [HTML Formatter](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/html-formatter): Format and minify HTML code for better readability or compactness.
- [Markdown Preview](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/markdown-preview): Write Markdown on the left and see a live preview on the right.
- [Query String Parser](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/query-string-parser): Parse URL query strings into readable key/value pairs and JSON entirely in your browser.
- [Color Converter](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/color-converter): Convert HEX, RGB, and HSL values instantly with a live color preview. Free and fully client-side.
- [HTTP Status Lookup](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/http-status-lookup): Search common HTTP response codes and their meanings while debugging APIs. Runs entirely in your browser.
- [MIME Type Lookup](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/mime-type-lookup): Look up common file extensions, content types, and browser-facing MIME labels while working with uploads or headers.
- [User Agent Parser](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/user-agent-parser): Parse raw browser user agent strings into browser, engine, operating system, and device hints.
- [HTTP Header Parser](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/http-header-parser): Parse raw HTTP request or response headers into structured rows and JSON.
- [URL Parser](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/url-parser): Parse URLs into their component parts (protocol, host, path, parameters).
- [XML Formatter](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/xml-formatter): Format, beautify or minify XML strings natively in your browser.
- [Image Compressor & Converter](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/image-compressor): Compress and convert images to JPEG, WebP, PNG or AVIF with a quality slider and optional resize. Files never leave your device.
- [PDF Merge & Split](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/pdf-merge-split): Merge several PDFs into one, or extract and reorder pages from a PDF. Files stay on your device; nothing is uploaded.
- [Open Graph & Meta Tag Generator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/meta-tag-generator): Generate title, description, Open Graph and Twitter Card meta tags, with search, X and LinkedIn/Slack previews.
- [CSS / JS Minifier](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/css-js-minifier): Minify JavaScript with Terser or CSS with csso, and see the original size, the minified size and the percentage saved. Runs entirely in your browser.
- [SVG Optimizer](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/svg-optimizer): Shrink SVG files by removing comments and metadata, rewriting paths and rounding numbers. Compare the original and optimized previews, then copy or download. Runs in your browser.
- [Favicon Generator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/favicon-generator): Turn one PNG, JPG or SVG into favicon PNGs, a multi-size favicon.ico, HTML link tags and a site.webmanifest. Files never leave your device.
- [CSS Gradient Generator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/css-gradient-generator): Build linear, radial and conic CSS gradients with editable color stops, a live preview and a copy-ready background declaration.
- [Cubic-Bezier Easing Editor](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/cubic-bezier-editor): Shape a CSS cubic-bezier() timing function by dragging its two handles or typing values, preview the motion, and copy the CSS.
- [Markdown to HTML](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/markdown-to-html): Convert Markdown into clean, copy-ready HTML source, with optional inline styles or a full HTML document. Runs entirely in your browser.
- [CSP Header Builder & Analyzer](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/csp-builder): Build Content-Security-Policy headers visually, audit existing policies for XSS risks, and export HTTP, Nginx, Apache, Express, or meta tag configs.

### Data Tools
- [Delimited File Data Validator (CSV / TSV / TXT)](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/csv-validator): Validate CSV, TSV, and delimited TXT files against custom column schema rules, required fields, data types, regex, and unique checks with row-level error reporting.
- [JSON to CSV & CSV to JSON Converter](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/json-to-csv): Convert JSON arrays to CSV spreadsheets or CSV files to JSON with nested object flattening and live tabular preview.
- [JSON to SQL Schema & Query Converter](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/json-to-sql): Convert JSON objects and arrays into SQL CREATE TABLE and INSERT INTO statements with automatic data type detection and multi-dialect support.
- [Age & Lifetime Milestone Calculator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/age-calculator): Calculate your exact age down to the second, total days, hours, minutes, heartbeats, breaths, next birthday countdown, and planetary ages.
- [SemVer Calculator & Range Tester](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/semver-calculator): Parse, validate, compare, sort, and calculate version increments according to SemVer 2.0.0 rules and NPM range expressions.
- [YAML <-> JSON Converter](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/yaml-json-converter): Convert bidirectionally between YAML and JSON with real-time validation, key sorting, and custom indentation options.
- [SQL Formatter & Prettifier](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/sql-formatter): Format, indent, validate, and minify SQL queries online. Capitalize keywords, format clauses, and clean up raw database queries.
- [CIDR & Subnet Calculator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/cidr-calculator): Calculate IPv4 CIDR blocks, usable host IP ranges, subnet masks, wildcard masks, and binary network breakdowns.
- [Large CSV & TXT Table Viewer (Up to 1GB)](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/csv-txt-viewer): View, parse, and analyze massive pipe-separated or delimited CSV and TXT files up to 1GB in a fast paginated table directly in your browser with zero memory freeze.
- [Number Base Converter](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/base-converter): Convert numbers across Decimal, Binary, Hexadecimal, Octal, and custom bases (Base 2-36) with two's complement details.
- [Timestamp Converter](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/timestamp-converter): Convert Unix timestamps, ISO dates, and local date strings instantly in your browser.
- [Cron Expression Parser](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/cron-parser): Parse, explain, and calculate execution times for 5-part cron expressions.
- [ASCII Table](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/ascii-table): Browse ASCII characters in decimal, hex, and binary with search and quick copy actions.
- [Unix Permissions Calculator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/unix-permissions-calculator): Convert read, write, and execute bits into chmod octal and symbolic permission strings.
- [Number to Words Converter](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/number-to-words): Convert numbers into English words — supports decimals, negative values, and magnitudes up to 999 trillion.
- [Cron Expression Generator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/cron-generator): Build cron scheduling expressions with interactive controls, presets, and human-readable descriptions.
- [Time Zone Converter & Meeting Planner](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/time-zone-converter): Pick a date and time in one time zone and see it in other zones, with a 24-hour planner that highlights working hours. Daylight saving aware, all in your browser.
- [TOML / JSON / YAML Converter](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/toml-json-yaml-converter): Convert between TOML, JSON and YAML in any direction. Parse errors show the line and column, and the result downloads with the right file extension. Runs in your browser.

### Crypto Tools
- [HMAC Generator & Calculator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/hmac-generator): Calculate HMAC-SHA256, HMAC-SHA512, and HMAC-SHA1 signatures for webhook verification and API security.
- [Bcrypt Hash Generator & Verifier](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/bcrypt-generator): Generate secure bcrypt password hashes with adjustable cost factors, analyze hash structures, and verify plaintext passwords against existing hashes.
- [SHA-256 Hash Generator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/sha256): Generate a SHA-256 hash from any input string instantly in your browser.
- [RSA Key Generator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/rsa-key-generator): Generate RSA public and private key pairs securely in your browser.
- [X.509 Certificate Decoder & Inspector](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/certificate-decoder): Decode and inspect PEM SSL/TLS X.509 certificates, SANs, validity dates, and fingerprints privately.
- [Webhook Signature Verifier](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/webhook-signature-verifier): Verify or generate Stripe, GitHub, Slack, Shopify, and Standard Webhooks HMAC signatures with timestamp replay checks in your browser.

### Analyze Tools
- [.env File Auditor & Secret Detector](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/env-auditor): Compare .env and .env.example files, detect missing or duplicate keys, catch leaked API secrets, and generate sanitized templates.
- [DevFlow Pipeline Studio](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/pipeline-studio): Visual developer workflow pipeline to chain, format, decode, filter, and hash payloads in zero-latency browser memory.
- [QR Code Scanner](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/qr-code-scanner): Scan and decode QR codes from your webcam or by uploading image files (PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG) completely offline and in-browser.
- [Word Counter](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/word-counter): Count words, characters, sentences, paragraphs and reading time instantly.
- [Word / Character Frequency](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/word-frequency): Count how often each word and character appears in a text, sorted by frequency, with percentages and copyable CSV.
- [Local AI Text Assistant](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/local-ai-text-assistant): Summarize text, surface keywords, detect action items, and estimate sentiment fully in JavaScript with no API.
- [Password Strength Analyzer](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/password-strength-analyzer): Analyze password entropy, estimate crack times, detect common patterns, and get actionable improvement tips — all in your browser.

### Developer Workflow Recipes
- [Developer Workflow Recipes Hub](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/recipes): Multi-step preconfigured pipelines chaining formatters, encoders, token decoders, and filters client-side.
- [Webhook Payload Inspector](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/recipes/webhook-payload-inspector): Extract, decode base64 bodies, and prettify webhook payloads from Stripe, GitHub, or Shopify entirely in browser memory.
- [JWT Auth Token Inspector](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/recipes/jwt-auth-verifier): Extract claims from Bearer authentication tokens, validate expiration timestamps, and generate SHA-256 fingerprints in local browser memory.
- [Base64 JSON Unpacker](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/recipes/base64-json-unpacker): Decode base64 and url-safe base64 strings directly into clean, syntax-highlighted, formatted JSON in a single step.
- [Log Cleaner & Deduplicator](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/recipes/server-log-cleaner): Extract error lines, deduplicate stack trace signatures, and clean messy server log files in browser memory.
- [SQL Identifier Sanitizer](https://www.toolbox4devs.com/recipes/sql-identifier-sanitizer): Batch transform frontend camelCase models and JSON keys into Postgres and MySQL compliant snake_case identifiers.
